name: Maverick Max
original_name: マーヴェリック・マックス
source:
Distant future. Max is a captain of the fastest space ship that delivers cargo between different start systems. He does not belong to the guild, so can take any kind of requests if he feels like, legal or illegal - does not matter. He has two assistant girls to accompany him. One day he gets a request to deliver a mysterious girl Matilda to a certain start. What awaits him there?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
遥远的未来。麦克斯是全宇宙最快货运飞船的船长，往返于不同星系之间运送货物。他不属于任何公会，因此只要自己愿意，什么委托都可以接，不论合法还是非法。两名少女助手始终陪伴在他身边。一天，他接到任务，要把一名神秘少女玛蒂尔达送往某个星球。那里有什么正在等待着他？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
